_about: Platt (logistic) calibration of the confidence score, P(genuine) = 1 / (1 + exp(-(a*z + b))), per module and per model fingerprint (see app/ml/engine.py). Fitted on writers the model never saw. Refit with training/calibrate_static.py / calibrate_dynamic.py. Optional per-entry "band": [lo, hi] = Inconclusive band for that module (overrides env CALIBRATED_BAND).

1395aa164620db5c.fitted_on: CEDAR writers 39-55 (the validation + testing writers of the model's own training split, never trained on); 10 refs, screened 14 genuine + 24 forgeries each; 646 screenings (Aa's Colab run, 2026-11-08). Training writers 1-38 behave the same (AUC 0.904).
